19: // GraphNodeAttachResourceConfig is an interface that must be implemented by nodes
20: // that want resource configurations attached.
21: type GraphNodeAttachResourceConfig interface {
22: 	GraphNodeConfigResource
23: 
24: 	// Sets the configuration, either to a present resource block or to
25: 	// a "removed" block commemorating a resource that has since been
26: 	// removed. Callers should always leave at least one of these
27: 	// arguments set to nil.
28: 	AttachResourceConfig(*configs.Resource, *configs.Removed)
29: }
30: 
31: // AttachResourceConfigTransformer goes through the graph and attaches
32: // resource configuration structures to nodes that implement
33: // GraphNodeAttachManagedResourceConfig or GraphNodeAttachDataResourceConfig.
34: //
35: // The attached configuration structures are directly from the configuration.
36: // If they're going to be modified, a copy should be made.
37: type AttachResourceConfigTransformer struct {
38: 	Config *configs.Config // Config is the root node in the config tree
39: 
40: 	resourceConfigIndex map[string]*configs.Resource
41: 	removedBlockIndex   map[string]*configs.Removed
42: 	providerMetaIndex   map[string]map[addrs.Provider]*configs.ProviderMeta
43: 
44: 	resourceStateIndex map[string]*states.Resource
45: 	missingStateKeys   []string
46: 
47: 	resourceSchemaIndex    map[string]*configschema.Block
48: 	providerSchemaIndex    map[string]*configschema.Block
49: 	provisionerSchemaIndex map[string]*configschema.Block
50: 	schemaVersions         map[string]uint64
51: 
52: 	orphanInstanceKeys []string
53: 	removedModuleKeys  []string
54: }

56: func (t *AttachResourceConfigTransformer) Transform(g *Graph) error {
57: 
58: 	// Go through and find GraphNodeAttachResource
59: 	for _, v := range g.Vertices() {
60: 		// Only care about GraphNodeAttachResource implementations
61: 		arn, ok := v.(GraphNodeAttachResourceConfig)
62: 		if !ok {
63: 			continue
64: 		}
65: 
66: 		// Determine what we're looking for
67: 		addr := arn.ResourceAddr()
68: 
69: 		// Get the configuration.
70: 		config := t.Config.Descendent(addr.Module)
71: 
72: 		if config == nil {
73: 			log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: %q (%T) has no configuration available", dag.VertexName(v), v)
74: 			continue
75: 		}
76: 
77: 		if r := config.Module.ResourceByAddr(addr.Resource); r != nil {
78: 			log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: attaching to %q (%T) config from %#v", dag.VertexName(v), v, r.DeclRange)
79: 			arn.AttachResourceConfig(r, nil)
80: 			if gnapmc, ok := v.(GraphNodeAttachProviderMetaConfigs); ok {
81: 				log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: attaching provider meta configs to %s", dag.VertexName(v))
82: 				if config.Module.ProviderMetas != nil {
83: 					gnapmc.AttachProviderMetaConfigs(config.Module.ProviderMetas)
84: 				} else {
85: 					log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: no provider meta configs available to attach to %s", dag.VertexName(v))
86: 				}
87: 			}
88: 		}
89: 
90: 		for _, r := range config.Module.Removed {
91: 			crAddr, ok := r.From.RelSubject.(addrs.ConfigResource)
92: 			if !ok {
93: 				// Not for a resource at all, so can't possibly match
94: 				continue
95: 			}
96: 			rAddr := crAddr.Resource
97: 			if rAddr != addr.Resource {
98: 				// Not the same resource
99: 				continue
100: 			}
101: 
102: 			log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: attaching to %q (%T) removed block from %#v", dag.VertexName(v), v, r.DeclRange)
103: 
104: 			// Validation ensures that there can't be both a resource/data block
105: 			// and a removed block referring to the same configuration, so
106: 			// we can assume that this isn't clobbering a non-removed resource
107: 			// configuration we already attached above.
108: 			arn.AttachResourceConfig(nil, r)
109: 		}
110: 	}
111: 
112: 	return nil
113: }
